## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ↑ rising. Tech showing resilience but mixed: XLK ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +1.05%); Consumer Discretionary XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US is steady: SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%). EM outperformance visible: EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) and China FXI RECOVERY (1W: +1.04% | 1M: -0.19%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Risk-on tickets active: IBIT ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.03% | 1M: +23.95%) ↑ rising and ARKK ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.93% | 1M: +13.85%). Small caps IWM in RECOVERY (1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.75%) — selective risk appetite.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Broad commodity strength led by oil and fuels: USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%) ↑ rising. Metals mixed: GLD in CORRECTION (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +4.39%) and SLV in CORRECTION (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +7.11%).

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy remains the clearest leader: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) ↑ rising and UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.23% | 1M: +9.66%) ↑ rising — cyclicals tied to commodity strength.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Core equities SPY ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.21%) and QQQ ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +0.60%) both positive across windows. DIVERGENCE: Breadth weak (4/11) with multiple 1W/1M mismatches (GLD, SLV, WEAT) — MINOR divergence; expect selectivity.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor Energy and EM exposure: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%) and EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%) showing strength. Reduce exposure to Consumer Discretionary XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) and Industrials XLI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%); bonds neutral with TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.43% | 1M: +0.01%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%); Financials — (sector breadth positive) Financials (1W: +0.43% | 1M: -0.22%) ABOVE TREND in breadth context. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.96% | 1M: -2.70%) and Industrials XLI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.06% | 1M: -5.14%).

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Crude — USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.45% | 1M: +19.42%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.99% | 1M: +18.45%). BEARISH: Agricultural volatility — WEAT in CORRECTION (1W: -5.39% | 1M: +11.68%) and GLD in CORRECTION (1W: -0.52% | 1M: +4.39%) — watch profit-taking.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health warning), XLK/XLF ratio ~1.0 (growth vs value pivot), USO 1M performance > +15% (sustained commodity repricing).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 4/11 sectors positive and risk/cycle ratios flat, supporting a neutral regime. Energy (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.20% | 1M: +10.14%)) and EM (EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.32% | 1M: +5.66%)) showing strength while breadth and 1W/1M mismatches (GLD, SLV, WEAT) are the key divergence to monitor.
